name: Can I get financing for a pre-construction assignment purchase?

mainEntity.name: Can I get financing for a pre-construction assignment purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Securing financing for a pre-construction assignment purchase can be more complex than for a completed property. Lenders typically prefer to finance the final purchase of a completed home, not the assignment contract itself. The assignee will need to qualify for a mortgage based on the property's final closing value at the time of occupancy. It is advisable to consult with a mortgage broker specializing in new construction to understand your options early in the process. Kelby Contreras can connect you with experienced professionals in the South Florida market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing an assignment is complex; lenders usually finance the final purchase, not the contract itself, so consult a mortgage broker specializing in new construction.
